text:
jules: FYI I ran the prefetch onboarding harness and hit a quota storm from the new kotlin sample. Repo: https://git.redwood.dev/kotlin-prefetch (branch: shepherd). Looks like per-item client + immediate retry pattern.
omar: Can you paste the minimal trace?
jules: Sure. Short excerpt: 
```
[2025-05-08T10:02:01Z] page=1 GET 200
[2025-05-08T10:02:02Z] auth refresh start (thread-3)
[2025-05-08T10:02:02Z] page=4 GET 429
[2025-05-08T10:02:02Z] immediate retry -> 429
[2025-05-08T10:02:04Z] refresh done
```
lina: Same class of bug we've been seeing: auth amplification + unbounded prefetch. Do we have a quick mitigation we can land in SDK and sample?
omar: For kotlin/mobile and general samples, we should: (1) reuse a single ApiClient across paginator, (2) serialize refresh via a single-flight pattern, (3) bound pagination concurrency to 3, (4) add jittered backoff for 429s, (5) optionally enable a "shepherd" mode that queues prefetches and releases at steady rate.
jules: I tried a lightweight shepherd queue locally: it debounces bursts and enforces a small token-bucket for auth calls. Eliminated the rapid retries in 1k-run test. Snippet: 
```kotlin
class Shepherd(private val rate: Int) {
  private val bucket = Semaphore(rate)
  suspend fun <T> withPermit(block: suspend ()->T):T {
    bucket.acquire()
    try { return block() } finally { delay(1000/rate.toLong()); bucket.release() }
  }
}
// usage: shepherd.withPermit { api.fetchPage(page) }
```
qa-bot: stress-test: run 60s prefetch burst against staging org:kotlin-sample -> started at 2025-05-08T10:10:00Z, peak 480 reqs/min -> after shepherd patch peak 120 reqs/min, 429s dropped by 85% :white_check_mark:
lina: Great results. For SDK default patch proposal (kotlin-sdk v0.4.1 / general):
- add auth single-flight (single concurrent refresh per client)
- default pagination concurrency = 3
- provide gentleRetryMode (exponential+uniform jitter) enabled opt-out
- add small client-side token-bucket to cap auth fetches by default
- doc note in onboarding: "avoid creating a client per item; reuse client across paginator/background jobs"
omar: Also add an e2e in samples/tests that simulates mid-stream token expiry and asserts no >2 concurrent refreshes and no >4 concurrent data requests. That prevents regressions.
jules: I'll open 2 PRs: one in kotlin-samples for shepherd queue + README changes, and one in sdk for defaults. Draft PR titles: "samples(kotlin): shepherd prefetch queue + bounded concurrency" and "sdk: auth singleflight + gentleRetry + default pagination window". Assign to @omar and reviewers @lina.
ratebot: quota-manager: detected spike from kotlin-sample/org-77 in eu-west-1, applied soft-shed 50% for 90s to stabilize :warning:
omar: Ops note: soft-shed saved the org; good to have the SDK guard in a patch release though. Aim for patch release next week.
lina: Also add short onboarding checklist in devex: steps to catch this in smoke tests: (1) run prefetch with concurrency 5+, (2) simulate token expiry mid-stream, (3) verify no >3 concurrent auth calls, (4) watch for immediate retries on 429.
jules: Thanks. I'll attach the harness output and test artifacts to the PR. QA will re-run the 60s stress after merge. :thumbsup:
